title: AI_ORCHESTRA Task
description: Machine-readable definition of a single bounded task delegated to a worker agent.

task_id.description: Unique identifier for the task. Also used as the worktree folder name.

project.description: Logical project the task belongs to, for example PODIUMHUB.

repository.description: Target repository, normally in owner/name form.

branch.description: Task branch the worker must operate on. Must never be a protected branch.

workspace.description: Absolute path of the isolated Git worktree for this task.

objective.description: Concise statement of what the task must achieve.

allowed_paths.description: Repository-relative paths the worker is authorized to modify.

forbidden_paths.description: Repository-relative paths the worker must not modify.

acceptance_criteria.description: Deterministically checkable or reviewable conditions for task completion.

test_command.description: Optional test command the Test Validator should execute.

notes.description: Optional additional context for the worker agent.
